quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this yellow pennant-shaped sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs warn drivers about no passing zones.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns you about an upcoming right curve.

questions.question: This sign indicates:
questions.explanation: Round yellow signs with black markings warn about railroad crossings. This is the only use for round warning signs.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow-green warning signs alert drivers to upcoming conditions like curves and sharp turns. Slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A left turn is allowed only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers not to turn left. It is illegal and unsafe to make a left turn at this location.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: This sign warns that:

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill. Slow down and be ready to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: If you want to turn left at an intersection with this red arrow signal, you should:

options.text: Turn, as long as you yield to other drivers.
Stop completely and proceed when it is safe.
Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and stay stopped while the red arrow is lit.
questions.explanation: A red left arrow means you must come to a complete stop. You must remain stopped as long as the red arrow is displayed.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
There is a detour to the right due to construction.
The road ahead makes a very sharp turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead makes a very sharp turn.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you to slow down for an abrupt change in road direction.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Keep going at your normal speed.
Look and listen. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen. Be ready to stop if a train is coming.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, you must look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can drive in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you about two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Last turn before a toll road.

questions.explanation: Orange signs mean there is work zone activity ahead. Stay alert for changes in driving conditions. This sign warns you that a flagger is coming. You must follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign tells you that road work is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in work zones.

questions.question: What does an orange sign like this mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs show construction areas. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has many curves.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a winding road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Construction or maintenance work is coming.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction or maintenance work is coming.
questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn drivers about upcoming hazards or special conditions. Orange warning signs usually show construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What message is on a red octagon-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: An octagon (eight-sided) sign always means "stop." You must come to a complete stop at this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can only drive straight ahead.
You are approaching a divided highway.
You can turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can turn left or go straight.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that your lane splits into two directions. You may turn left or continue straight in a lane with this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead. Drivers in that lane need to merge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are approaching the end of a divided highway.
You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are approaching the beginning of a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming so you can prepare to stop or turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may be merging into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that the right lane is ending and you need to be ready to merge.

questions.question: This sign shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs pointing downward mean yield. Slow down and stop if needed. Stop at the marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you when animals, people, or bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on the road.
There is a series of curves ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions just ahead. This sign warns of a winding road with many curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. The arrow shows the direction that is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join your lane.
Traffic is merging from another road. Stay in the right lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely join your lane.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that cars are entering from another road. Check your mirrors and change lanes if you can to give merging drivers a safe space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.
Slow down; road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down; road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming up. Start slowing down when you see this warning.

questions.question: This symbol is used for:
questions.explanation: A bright orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it moves slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, road work vehicles, or horse-drawn vehicles. It looks orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed on slow-moving vehicles.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and move to the right lane.
Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
Slower traffic must exit on the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in the right lane if you are driving slower than other traffic.
questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means slower drivers should use the right lane and keep the left lane open for faster traffic to pass.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are coming to:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. It tells you to slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to potential dangers. This sign tells you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. You cannot turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming steep hill. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a traffic rule you must obey. It means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows there is a crosswalk ahead, whether marked on the pavement or not. Be alert and let pedestrians cross safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before going down the hill.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn you about conditions ahead. This sign tells you to be ready for traffic to merge in from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction or maintenance work is happening.

questions.correctAnswerText: Construction or maintenance work is happening.
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance areas. They help drivers and pedestrians stay safe. Fines can be doubled in areas marked by these signs.

questions.question: What does this yellow warning sign mean?

options.text: A school or school crosswalk is near.
Slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.explanation: This sign is placed on roads near schools. It tells drivers to slow down, drive carefully, and watch for children.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see a yield sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You cannot turn when the light is red.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot turn when the light is red.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers what traffic laws they must follow. This sign means you cannot turn right or left when the red light is on.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this yellow sign?

options.text: Stop at the crosswalk until a crossing guard tells you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign tells you that you are near a school. Be aware and stop if children are crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers about a school zone or school crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that traffic may merge from the right, so be ready to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead, such as a change in traffic direction, a steep hill, or dangerous conditions that require you to take action.

questions.question: What is this bicyclist signaling?
questions.explanation: Bicycles do not have turn signals. Bicyclists use hand and arm signals instead. A straight left arm means the bicyclist is turning left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes going the same direction will soon merge into one lane.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a reverse curve. The road curves to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: You see this sign at a railroad crossing with no signal. What should you do?

options.text: Continue at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with this sign, slow down and look both ways. Listen for any trains and be prepared to stop. Never try to drive faster than an oncoming train.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the road will curve right first, then curve left. Adjust your speed to safely navigate the curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep or long downgrade or hill ahead. It may have sharp curves.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: Turn left only on a green arrow.
Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
Wait for the solid green light before turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left on a green light when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A "yield" sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. Then you can proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that bicycles may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: If you see a sign over your lane with an arrow and the word "only", you should:

options.text: Drive in the direction of the arrow.
Look for a destination sign to follow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a lane control sign. It tells you that you must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: An orange and red triangular sign on a vehicle means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like tractors, maintenance vehicles, and carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: Traffic lights from top to bottom are in this order:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to upcoming conditions. This sign warns that traffic lights are ahead at an intersection.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see it if you try to enter an expressway ramp the wrong way.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An octagon-shaped sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop at the stop line. If there is no stop line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop at a point where you can see oncoming traffic.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: You must drive either right or left.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must drive either right or left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that the road splits and you must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: This sign shows:

options.text: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height for vehicles in this state.
The maximum width for vehicles on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The height from the road to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This is a low clearance warning sign. It shows how much space is between the road and the bottom of a bridge or overpass.

questions.question: This red and white sign means you should:

options.text: Stop and look both ways before proceeding.
Let traffic on the road ahead pass before you enter or cross.
Keep moving at the same speed and look for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road ahead pass before you enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A yield sign is three-sided. It means you must slow down and be ready to stop so that any vehicle, cyclist, or pedestrian can pass first.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This yellow sign means:

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You often see this sign at intersections where oncoming traffic is heavy.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the divided road is ending. You are now entering a two-way highway with traffic in both directions.

questions.question: What information do blue traffic signs provide?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services for drivers. They tell you about rest areas, food, gas, hospitals, and other help along the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a traffic law sign. You must obey it. Where this sign is posted, you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change in direction or narrowing of roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will change direction or become narrower. You may see this sign on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: What does this warning sign tell you?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to conditions just ahead. This sign warns that one lane is ending. Move left safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell a driver?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is coming. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange or yellow vests or bright jackets. They use paddles and flags to direct traffic safely through construction zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is dangerous and slippery. Slow down on wet roads because it takes longer to stop your car.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to stop if the light is flashing.

questions.explanation: A yellow sign with a traffic signal picture warns you that a traffic signal is coming. Get ready to respond to it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until it is safe and clear to pass through the intersection.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: You are nearing a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
You should stop and wait for a signal before crossing the railroad tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are nearing a railroad crossing and should get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is near. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing red traffic light?

options.text: You are going the wrong direction.
Treat it like a stop sign.
You cannot go until the light turns green.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light works like a stop sign. Come to a complete stop at the stop line or before the crosswalk. Let all other vehicles and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A side road will join ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A side road will join ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black marks. They tell you to watch out for something ahead. This sign alerts you to a side road joining the main road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and let traffic on the main road go first.
Always come to a complete stop.
Turn on your signal and drive into traffic at normal speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let traffic on the main road go first.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must wait for traffic on the other road before you go. You do not have to stop completely if no vehicles are coming, but always slow down and be careful.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even without a stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means a school zone or school crossing is near. Stay alert and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black marks. They tell you about conditions coming up. This sign warns that you are leaving a one-way road and entering a two-way road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that pedestrians cross here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for vehicles entering from the side.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead is divided by an island or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must yield the right-of-way at this sign. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass. Stop if needed before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: When displayed on the rear of a vehicle, this sign means:

options.text: The vehicle is being drawn by an animal.
The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is traveling at 25 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like bicycles, horse-drawn vehicles, or farm vehicles display this sign to warn other drivers that they travel at 25 mph or slower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with caution.
Come to a complete stop as quickly as possible.
Stop and proceed only when the intersection is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and proceed with caution. You do not need to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign is a traffic law. You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.
